item.title: Readable Sale Copy Every Size

turns.text: I need matching plant-shop ads in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9. Include exactly: “Fern House”, “Weekend Plant Sale”, “20% off all indoor plants”, “Saturday & Sunday”, “Visit 24 Willow Lane”. Use leafy plants and a clean green-and-cream look. Keep every line easy to read in all three, especially the address—rearrange things instead of shrinking the whole design.

item.tests: Preserves complete, readable ad copy and visual hierarchy when adapting one design to three substantially different canvas shapes.

answer_sheet.Sale dates: Use Saturday & Sunday as written; no calendar dates are needed.

must_haves: Three finished images have the requested 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9 aspect ratios.
All five specified text strings appear correctly and completely in every variant.
Every text line, including 'Visit 24 Willow Lane', is comfortably readable when each image is viewed at its delivered size without zooming.
Text has clear contrast against its background and is not obscured by leaves or other text.
No text is clipped, pushed against the canvas edge or distorted to fit.
The variants retain matching leafy imagery and green-and-cream styling while adjusting text placement or line breaks to suit each shape.

I always worry that an ad can look lovely at first glance but become hard to read when you actually try to find the details. The formats I need are 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9, and the wording to include exactly is “Fern House”, “Weekend Plant Sale”, “20% off all indoor plants”, “Saturday & Sunday”, “Visit 24 Willow Lane”. Please use leafy plants and a clean green-and-cream look across the set. Keep every line easy to read in all three, especially the address, and rearrange things to fit rather than shrinking the whole design.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the ads because Magic Hour reported **insufficient credits**. No images were created.

The set is planned around a cream background, forest-green typography, and leafy plants kept clear of the text:
- **1:1:** Centered hierarchy with a prominent address footer.
- **9:16:** Vertically stacked copy with generous spacing.
- **16:9:** Copy on the left, plants on the right, and a clear address strip below.

All three would retain your five exact lines, with layouts rearranged—not simply shrunk—to protect readability. Once credits are available, I can generate the set.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create ONE finished square 1:1 plant-shop advertisement, the master design for a coordinated three-format campaign. Clean editorial graphic design, warm cream #F5F1E6 background, deep forest green #173F2D typography, sage #8BA68A accents. Elegant bold serif headlines and highly legible clean sans-serif supporting type. Botanical illustrations of lush leafy fern and monstera in simple cream pots confined to side/lower corners, NEVER behind text. Spacious but LARGE text, strong contrast, generous safe margins. Include EXACTLY these five text items with exact spelling and punctuation, no other copy: "Fern House", "Weekend Plant Sale", "20% off all indoor plants", "Saturday & Sunday", "Visit 24 Willow Lane". Brand at top, large sale headline beneath, prominent discount, clear days, address in a dedicated prominent cream footer with forest-green border. The entire address must be large, bold, readily readable, not fine print. Headline can wrap between words; keep supporting text items intact. Clean flat print-ready design, no mockup, no watermark. Prioritize accurate readable lettering above botanical detail.
